description: This file defines an interface for MetadataHeader, representing an association between a MetadataHeaderKey and a JsonValue. It provides static factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization methods, comparison logic, and inner classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: MetadataHeader
classes.description: An interface representing a metadata header that associates a MetadataHeaderKey with a JsonValue. It supports creation, JSON parsing, comparison, and retrieval of its key and value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of MetadataHeader given a key and value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of MetadataHeader from a JSON object.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key of this header.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this header.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this header to another header based on key and value.
